params.body:
A page on gentells.com for every source an author cites in a post or a report: what the source is, where Gentells cites it, the trends it feeds, and the link out to the publisher. It needs the pipeline PR that adds `/internal/projection/cited-sources`, so merge that one first.

## Who sees what

An author's citation is open to every reader, like a footnote; a report prints its sources in full anyway. The Observatory's own sources behind a trend are unchanged: they stay with the Sources ability.

## What is added

- **`cited_sources`** (migration and `CitedSource` model), filled by `Projection::reconcileCitedSources()` in `gentells:reconcile`. The set is replaced wholesale. A malformed key or url is skipped. An empty answer while pages exist is refused (`ProjectionRefused`), so a pipeline that answers with nothing for a moment cannot take every page down, along with every link printed in a report.
- **`/sources/{key}`** (`CitedSourceController`, `pages/source.blade.php`):
  - What the page shows: title, publisher and date, "Read it at <host>", the full address, "Where Gentells cites it" (reports with the source's number in their list, posts with the sentences the source backs) and "Trends it feeds".
  - Only posts, reports and trends that this site holds are listed.
  - `noindex, follow`: the publisher's own page is the one that should rank.
- **The post page:** a citation with a held page keeps its publisher for every reader and links to its page ("View source"). Its url no longer goes out with the evidence, since the page carries the link. A citation without a held page, and every Observatory signal, follow the old rule.

## Checked

- `tests/Feature/CitedSourcePageTest.php` (5):
  - the reconcile replaces the set and skips malformed rows, and an empty answer is refused;
  - the page opens for a stranger with noindex and the content above, and an unknown or malformed key gives 404;
  - a free reader's post links the citation to its page, while the Observatory signal keeps neither name nor link;
  - a citation with no page held yet falls back to the old rule.
- Full suite: all pass except `BuildStampTest`, which fails in any worktree, and `SocialLoginTest`, because the vendor folder used here lacks Socialite.
- Looked at in a local site at desktop and phone width.
params.title: Cited source pages on gentells.com
